authority: Issue #79 PR1 subsector taxonomy - initial Healthcare/Pharmaceutical decomposition
rationale: TOPIX-17 sector level is too coarse to detect localized capital flows. Pharmaceutical sector remained COLD while Biotechnology subsector saw +3.6% intraday inflow. This taxonomy enables Sector → Subsector → Stock hierarchy for early flow detection.
